summary: Reviewed DEMO-PREVIEW R-1 (confirmed) against the PRD text, requirements/tasks/traceability/decisions records, the base..HEAD diff (06b8e82..4d41b8b, including intermediate commit 1fb70a0), all consumers of the shared formatting constants, and the actual test assertions. No implementation mismatch found at HEAD: preview() now truncates to a new PREVIEW_LIMIT=8 while DISPLAY_LIMIT stays 12, so receipt_reference() (the only other consumer) keeps its base behavior. The intermediate commit 1fb70a0 had changed the shared DISPLAY_LIMIT to 8 (which would have regressed receipts); HEAD reverts that. Remaining uncertainty is evidence, not code: the layout.png source is unavailable, the only quality report is a synthetic compile claim with no test execution, and logical test IDs have no explicit mapping to test cases. Absence of findings is not a delivery pass. Elapsed time/token usage unmeasured.

findings.claim: Implementation supports R-1 'preview shows at most 8 characters': preview() truncates with a new dedicated PREVIEW_LIMIT of 8.

evidence.observation: Preview labels must display at most eight characters; receipt reference formatting must remain unchanged.
R-1 status confirmed; acceptance: preview at most 8 chars and receipt references retain existing behavior.
Base had only DISPLAY_LIMIT = 12 and preview returned value[:DISPLAY_LIMIT] (12 chars).

findings.claim: Receipt preservation requirement is met at HEAD: shared DISPLAY_LIMIT remains 12 and receipt_reference is unchanged from base; the only consumers of the formatting constants are preview/receipt/tests.

evidence.observation: Imports DISPLAY_LIMIT and returns value[:DISPLAY_LIMIT]; file not in changed_paths.
Identical to HEAD: truncates to DISPLAY_LIMIT (12).

findings.claim: History risk (resolved at HEAD): intermediate commit 1fb70a0 changed shared DISPLAY_LIMIT from 12 to 8, which would have shortened receipt references too; commit 4d41b8b restored DISPLAY_LIMIT=12 and introduced PREVIEW_LIMIT. Any build/deploy taken from 1fb70a0 would violate the receipt preservation requirement.

evidence.observation: Diff -DISPLAY_LIMIT = 12 / +DISPLAY_LIMIT = 8 with preview still using DISPLAY_LIMIT.
Net base..HEAD change adds PREVIEW_LIMIT = 8 and leaves DISPLAY_LIMIT = 12.

findings.claim: Test assertions, as written, cover both acceptance criteria including the 8-char boundary and a >12-char receipt input, but they have not been shown to run.

evidence.observation: assertEqual(receipt_reference('abcdefghijklmnop'), 'abcdefghijkl') - 16-char input truncated to 12, matching base behavior.
Only a 'compile' result marked passed, labeled 'synthetic fixture claim'; tested_at says 'not a real measured run'. No unit test result recorded.

gaps: Source S2 sources/layout.png (requirements.json prd_paths and prd-intake.json S2) is unavailable in the snapshot (verify-inputs reports source_unavailable); any visual/layout constraint on the preview label could not be checked.
No executed test evidence: quality-report.json records only a synthetic compile claim at HEAD 4d41b8b; tests/test_preview.py has never been shown to pass. Assertions were inspected, not run.

traceability.json references logical test IDs TEST-PREVIEW and TEST-RECEIPT with no explicit mapping to test functions/commands; mapping to test_preview_limit / test_receipt_reference_preserved is inferred by name only.

No impact.json record exists for the feature; consumer coverage was established by searching all tracked files (only src/receipt.py and tests use the formatting module), not from a recorded impact analysis.
traceability.json lists src/receipt.py under code for R-1 although it is unchanged; this is a record-accuracy note, not a behavior defect.
Feature status is provisional while R-1 is confirmed and task T-1 is marked done; delivery acceptance is not established by this review.
Behavior for non-string/None inputs or multi-byte characters (characters vs code units) is unspecified by sources and not reviewed.
